players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Returned to the lineup as DH after missing 3 games. Went 0-for-2 with a strikeout and groundout. Mariners won 5-4 over Atlanta.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Dominant night: 3-for-4, 2 home runs, 3 RBI in a 9-1 Phillies rout of Oakland. Harper's HR total moves to 9 on the season; PHI scored 6 in the 1st inning.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Giants dropped a 5-10 home loss to the Padres. Arraez went 1-for-4, no RBI. His batting average remains among the best in the NL at .316.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: NYM @ COL game postponed due to rain. Bichette did not play; game expected to be made up later.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle returned to the Tigers lineup after Monday's scheduled off day. Went 0-for-2 with a stolen base vs Boston.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: Cubs were shut out 0-1 by Cincinnati on Nick Martinez's gem. PCA went 0-for-3; Cubs have dropped 4 of their last 5.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Excellent game: 3-for-4, 2 RBI, 1 SB as Padres routed Giants 10-5 at San Francisco. Merrill is heating up, now batting .218 with 6 SB on the season.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Went 0-for-3 including a called strikeout in the 4th inning as Dodgers fell 1-2 to Houston. Placed on 10-day IL on May 6 with a Grade 1 left groin strain. Was batting .315 with 9 HR and 34 RBI in 33 games before the injury.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice sat out May 5 due to a bruised left hand from a fielding play on May 3. X-rays negative; he is day-to-day and could return within a few days.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: NYM @ COL game postponed by rain. Williams did not pitch.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler was not scheduled to start May 5. Next start TBD in coming days.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Left in the 1st inning after 2/3 IP after being struck on the left thumb by a 96 mph Jose Ramirez comebacker. Suffered a contusion; Royals still won 5-3 on Cinco de Mayo to extend their win streak to five. Ragans expects to make his next start vs Detroit and is not on the IL.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns was not in the Reds' rotation on May 5. Next start TBD.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Jacob deGrom made the start for Texas on May 5. Eovaldi is scheduled to pitch on May 6.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Shohei Ohtani made the start for the Dodgers vs Houston on May 5; LAD lost 1-2 to Peter Lambert. Sheehan did not pitch.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: The Angels called up Sam Aldegheri from Triple-A Salt Lake on Monday to start Tuesday vs Chicago White Sox. Detmers did not pitch.

injuries.name: Teoscar Hernandez
injuries.note: Grade 1 left groin strain. Placed on IL May 6. Was batting .315/9HR/34RBI in 33 games before injury.

injuries.name: Stanton/Rice
injuries.note: Bruised left hand from fielding a pickoff throw May 3. X-rays negative. Out of lineup May 4-5.

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: Hit by 96 mph Ramirez comebacker in 1st inning May 5. Expects to make next start vs Detroit. Not on IL.
